subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Travelers said the rules made the space comfortable for everyone.”?
options: After a month, the school changed the rule slightly.
After a month, the fruit boxes sold out almost every day.
Later, the table became popular before big tests or after busy mornings.
After a month, the piano stayed popular.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After a month, the school changed the rule slightly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After a month, the fruit boxes sold out almost every day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Later, the table became popular before big tests or after busy mornings.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Travelers said the rules made the space comfortable for everyone. After a month, the piano stayed popular.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
